title: Les aventures du philosophe inconnu, en la recherche & en l'invention de la pierre philosophale
shelf_note: A 1646 French alchemical work (Belin); the leaf is 17th-century French type, consistent with the record. No tradition or collection is given in the packet to test against.
structure_note: Record 162 carries printed p. 140, an offset of 22 consistent with front matter. The 7 backsteps and 8 repeats in printed numbers cannot be judged from one page; with 221 of 256 pages numbered, they are more likely misread or repeated numerals than a splice. The counts disagree with each other: structure says pages_translated 0 against a field of 236, and 256 page records against pages_count 254. That looks like a counting or field drift, not something visible on the leaf.

book_verdict: The transcription is near-perfect and the translation is faithful, with sensible glosses on the duel idiom and the Last Judgment. The only defects on sight are leaked arrow/bold markup around the running head and a continuity meta that quotes text not on this leaf.
